package.name: rb3_control
package.description: Betaflight flight-controller bridge for the Qualcomm RB3 Gen 2: MSP over USB (/dev/ttyACM0) exposed as ROS 2 topics, with the radio keeping arm/disarm and takeover through Betaflight MSP override. Also publishes the RB3's own IMU, barometer and magnetometer, read through Qualcomm's SEE sensor-core stack.
